b: I have found so much joy and contentment with simple and frugal living.
For me, I try to get things second hand. Donate what I don't need or use any more.
I love being at home and cooking most of my meals, making coffee at home, reading a book I borrowed from the library.
I look forward to routines like family dinner or Church on Sunday rather than big trips like vacations.
I am making my own kitchen cleaning sprays, washing most laundry with cold water and appropriate amount of detergent. I would like to start asking my own bread too.
I do most of my beauty routine at home like dyeing and cutting my hair. I use mostly drug store skin care and make up.
I am way more fulfilled than when I was travelling, going out for food often, using $100 skincare.
I am trying to be more frugal and just enjoy the little things! what do you like to do?
